title: King of the Salad Cucumber - 2x Mini Plug Plants - High-yielding Salad Cucumber
description:
Grow Your Own Crisp, Refreshing Cucumbers!


KEY FEATURES
• High-yielding variety with smooth, dark green fruits
• Crisp, refreshing texture and mild, sweet flavour
• Excellent for salads, sandwiches, and fresh eating
• Good disease resistance and heat tolerance
• Suitable for outdoor or greenhouse growing


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Cucumis sativus
Colour: Dark green (fruit)
Season: July to September (harvest)
Growth Habit: Climbing/Trailing
Flavour: Mild, sweet, and refreshing
Time to Harvest: Typically 2-3 weeks after flowering


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun
Soil: Fertile, well-drained soil
Watering: Keep soil evenly moist, especially during flowering and fruiting
Spacing: 60 cm between plants, 90 cm between rows
Height: 150-200cm with support
Spread: Trailing habit, can be trained up supports
Hardiness: UK H2 (1 to 5 °C)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in a warm, sunny, and sheltered position.
• Water regularly and deeply at the base of the plant, avoiding wetting leaves.
• Feed weekly with a balanced slow-release fertilizer, switching to higher potassium during fruiting.
• Provide support (e.g., canes or netting) for climbing plants.
• Harvest cucumbers when 6-8 inches long to encourage continuous production and prevent bitterness.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
